summary: Regression run for the iteration_3 minor fixes. Backend: 36/36 pytest pass, including the new /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4_fixes.py with 14 tests: report PATCH saves and persists (404 for an unknown id, 422 for a bad type or progress); demoting the ADMIN_EMAIL owner to engineer or supervisor returns 400 and the role stays manager; engineer gets 403; export days=0/367/-1 returns 422 and days=1/366 returns 200; export with days=1 and days=7 uses report_date (today's report is in, a report dated 10 days back is out, the full export has both); dashboard 'Active projects' KPI counts only Active/At risk projects. Frontend (Playwright, manager signed in through Clerk): sidebar email is lowercase (text-transform none). At 390px, issue/report rows stack status and date under the title, the date stays on one line (15px high) and there is no horizontal overflow. The report row is a div[role=button] with aria-expanded; it expands/collapses by click, Enter and Space. The issue status select is not nested in a button and changing it saves the status without expanding the row. 'Edit report' opens the form prefilled (title, workforce, summary, type) with no project select and no file input; saving updates the row in place (title, Weekly, 15 on site). Slider: ArrowRight saved 80 -> 85, End saved 100 and set status Completed. Tab counts: after saving an issue the modal closes with the count already at 2, and the report count goes 0 -> 1 when the modal closes. Smoke: dashboard loads; a report with an attachment created from the dashboard has 1 file; the Excel export downloads a valid PK file. All fixes verified.

minor.issue: ReportPatch has no min_length on title/summary, so the API accepts an empty title or summary (the UI blocks this with required fields).
The owner guard checks the stored email only. If the ADMIN_EMAIL user has no db record or email yet, nothing protects them (edge case).

ui_bugs.issue: After a keyboard save, the row remounts because its key is `${a.id}-${a.progress}`, so the slider loses focus (document.activeElement becomes body). A keyboard user has to re-focus after every arrow press. Use key={a.id} and sync local state with useEffect.

action_items: Optional: key ActivityRow by a.id so the slider keeps keyboard focus after saving
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard 'Portfolio progress' delta uses on_track (Active + Completed) while 'Active projects' now counts Active + At risk, so the two KPIs use different definitions (e.g. '3 on track' next to '4 active'). Consider aligning them.
Export daily/weekly: issues are still windowed by created_at, while reports now use report_date. Open issues are always included, so this is acceptable.
